bias.en: Recovering · back above the 200-day, under the 30-day
bias.zh: 修复中 · 重回 200 日均线上方，仍在 30 日均线下方

read.en: Amazon rose 2.2% on Nov 2 to $245.63, trading between $242.28 and $253.81 on 1.4 times average volume. It is above the rising 200-day ($243.4) and below the falling 5-day ($247.5), 10-day ($251.0) and 30-day ($252.6) and the rising 100-day ($251.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 23 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($258.42), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月2日上涨 2.2%，收于 $245.63，盘中区间 $242.28–253.81，成交量为均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于上行的 200 日均线（$243.4）上方，低于下行的 5 日（$247.5）、10 日（$251.0）和 30 日均线（$252.6）以及上行的 100 日均线（$251.9）。MACD 自 10月23日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$258.42），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $243.4–244.7 zone (200-day, September lows), now support, but the push to $253.8 faded under the 10, 30 and 100-day. Resistance is $247.5–249.1 (5-day, Oct 29 high), then $251.0–253.8 (averages, Nov 2 high) and $258.4–259.5 (SAR, Sep 21 high). Support is $242.3–244.7, then $229.4 (Oct 30 low) and $225.6–226.2. A close above $253.8 would target $258–260; below $242.3, $229.

s.en: 200-day average $243.4; Sep 16 and Sep 28 lows ($244.3–244.7), reclaimed; Nov 2 low $242.3
Jun 25 and Jul 29 lows ($225.6–226.2); Jan 2 low $224.7
